page.overview:
Who is 1992 Gryffindor vs Slytherin Quidditch match spectators?

1992 Gryffindor vs Slytherin Quidditch match spectators belongs to Harry Potter. 250px|thumb|The unidentified spectators sitting amongst Hogwarts staff Filius Flitwick, Irma Pince, Severus Snape, and Pomona Sprout, along with Lucius Malfoy In November 1992, a number of unidentified spectators attended the Quidditch match between the Gryffindor and Slytherin Quidditch teams.

This individual was a wizard with grey hair and a beard. During the match, he sat behind Filius Flitwick and beside another wizard. He appluaded after the Slytherin Quidditch team scored, and was extremely shocked after Draco Malfoy was injured.
